changes.summary: Bounded no-follow report discovery and parsing; exact run, pack, incident, digest, step, and result reconciliation; malformed newest records remain invalid instead of falling back to older success.
Bounded pack input, safe pack-id and root checks, exact pack digest in the report, immutable POSIX publication, and exclusive-create Windows publication.
Invalid or conflicting latest run custody blocks automatic replay.
Successful-run fixture now uses the existing report-producing owner, with only the final command executor replaced.
Forged/minimal, duplicate-key, symlink, conflicting-newer, genuine owner-report, and actual clear-entrypoint cases.

verification.python_compileall: passed for all changed Python files

known_legacy_expectation.result: fails under the stricter contract because the fixture writes only a hand-authored run_id/pack_id/status object and expects it to clear quarantine
known_legacy_expectation.interpretation: obsolete test fixture; equivalent actual clear positive control passes in test_remediation_run_custody.py with an owner-produced report and real integrity/admission gates

limitations: The report remains an owner-produced local claim. Filesystem custody and internally reconciled step rows do not independently authenticate the runner or prove an external effect.
Windows publication uses exclusive creation and was not executed on Windows; it is not claimed equivalent to POSIX descriptor-relative immutable publication.

A crash after command execution and before durable report publication can leave an incomplete operation without a run result. The next implementation dependency is a durable pre-execution intent/attempt record that prevents automatic replay after interruption.
